claims: The Derpy McFlurry is a limited-edition McDonald's dessert.
The Derpy McFlurry was launched on March 31, 2026.
The Derpy McFlurry was launched as part of the "KPop Demon Hunters" collaboration.
The Derpy McFlurry features vanilla soft serve.
The Derpy McFlurry features wild berry sauce.
The Derpy McFlurry features berry-flavored popping pearls.
The Derpy McFlurry is inspired by the "Derpy Tiger" character.
The Derpy McFlurry was released as a limited-edition item alongside "KPop Demon Hunters" meals.
The Derpy McFlurry is part of a larger South Korean-inspired campaign.
The South Korean-inspired campaign features collectible photo cards.
In Australia, the menu mentions a variation of the Derpy McFlurry with brown sugar sauce and tapioca pearls.
The primary promotion of the Derpy McFlurry is the wild berry flavor.
The Derpy McFlurry is available in regular and mini sizes.
The Derpy McFlurry's flavor profile is described as leaning toward blueberry.
The Derpy McFlurry is described as having a sweet, slightly tangy taste.
